Hi there, sorry a dummy question
When the Hiperparameter definition has fixed = TRUE, it means that it wont change during all the fitting of the model and will be taken as a constant?

messages.author: 9940b4fcc153c7d7
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Parameter Fixed when defining the Hyperparameters
parts:
Yes. It will be fixed to the initial value. But this value is on the internal scale, e.g. log precision.
